lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Tidying Up.
lines.zh: 收拾房间。

lines.en: Peppa and George are in their bedroom playing with their toys. George, let's play dollies and dinosaurs!
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治在他们的卧室里玩玩具。乔治，我们来玩娃娃和恐龙吧！

lines.en: What is that? It looks like a horrible monster!
lines.zh: 那是什么？看起来像个可怕的怪物！

lines.en: Dinosaur! It's a dinosaur! Help! Help! Help!
lines.zh: 恐龙！是一只恐龙！救命！救命！救命！

lines.en: Daddy Pig is in the sitting room, reading his newspaper. Mummy Pig is reading her book.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸在客厅里看报纸。猪妈妈在看书。

lines.en: What are they doing?
lines.zh: 他们在干什么呢？

lines.en: Help! Help! Peppa, George, what's going on? What's all this noise? Whoa! Help!
lines.zh: 救命！救命！佩奇，乔治，发生什么事了？怎么这么吵？哎哟！救命！

lines.en: What on earth is going on? What a lot of noise! And look at all this mess on the floor. Someone could trip over and hurt themselves.
lines.zh: 到底是怎么回事？太吵了！还有，看看地上这一团乱。有人会被绊倒受伤的。

lines.en: Someone did trip over and hurt themselves! Oh, dear, poor Daddy Pig! Come on, children, let's do a bit of tidying up.
lines.zh: 已经有人被绊倒受伤啦！哦，天哪，可怜的猪爸爸！来吧，孩子们，我们来收拾一下。

lines.en: But Mummy, we're playing dollies and dinosaurs! You can play again when you've tidied up.
lines.zh: 可是妈妈，我们在玩娃娃和恐龙呢！收拾好你们就可以接着玩。

lines.en: But it's all George's mess. Is it really? So this must be one of George's lovely dresses?
lines.zh: 可这些都是乔治弄乱的。真的吗？那这应该是乔治漂亮的裙子之一喽？

lines.en: No. Or maybe some of the mess is mine.
lines.zh: 不是。也许有一部分是乱的。

lines.en: Right, I'll help George tidy, and Mummy Pig can help Peppa. We can have a race: girls against boys!
lines.zh: 好吧，我帮乔治收拾，猪妈妈帮佩奇。我们可以来场比赛：女生队对男生队！

lines.en: Good idea! Let's see who can tidy up first. Ready, steady, go!
lines.zh: 好主意！看谁先收拾完。各就各位，预备，开始！

lines.en: We're winning! No, you're not!
lines.zh: 我们要赢了！不，你们才没有！

lines.en: Oh, what's this? Teddy! I've been looking for you! Quick, Peppa, put Teddy in your toy basket!
lines.zh: 哦，这是什么？泰迪！我一直在找你！快点，佩奇，把泰迪放进你的玩具筐里！

lines.en: There! Now these books.
lines.zh: 好啦！现在轮到这些书。

lines.en: Lovely! What do we have here? Dinosaur! That's right, it's a dinosaur book. It's George's pop-up dinosaur book!
lines.zh: 太好了！我们这儿有什么？恐龙！没错，是一本恐龙书。是乔治的立体恐龙书！

lines.en: This is a Tyrannosaurus Rex! Tyrannosaurus Rex! That's right!
lines.zh: 这是霸王龙！霸王龙！答对了！

lines.en: Oh, this is a brontosaurus! Brontosaurus! Yes!
lines.zh: 哦，这是雷龙！雷龙！是的！

lines.en: And this is a triceratops! Triceratops! Well done, George! George loves dinosaurs.
lines.zh: 还有这是三角龙！三角龙！真棒，乔治！乔治喜欢恐龙。

lines.en: Daddy, George, you've stopped tidying up. You'll lose the race! Oh, yes, the race! Come on, George, put this back on the bookshelf!
lines.zh: 爸爸，乔治，你们不收拾了。你们要输掉比赛啦！哦，对，比赛！快点，乔治，把这个放回书架上去！

lines.en: Daddy, you're very slow at tidying up. Mummy and I are going to win! No, we're going to win!
lines.zh: 爸爸，你收拾得太慢了。我和妈妈要赢啦！不对，要赢的是我们！

lines.en: We win! No, we win! We all win! Look how tidy the room is!
lines.zh: 我们赢了！不，我们赢了！我们都赢了！看这房间多整洁呀！

lines.en: Hooray! What a tidy room! Well done, everyone!
lines.zh: 太好啦！房间真整洁！大家干得好！

lines.en: Mummy, now that we've tidied our room, can we play dollies and dinosaurs again? Yes, you can carry on with your game now! Yippee!
lines.zh: 妈妈，既然我们把房间收拾好了，能再玩娃娃和恐龙了吗？可以，你们现在可以继续玩啦！太好啦！

lines.en: Where are my dollies? Where is Mr. Dinosaur?
lines.zh: 我的娃娃在哪儿？恐龙先生在哪儿？

lines.en: Here they are! Grr! Dinosaur! Ah! It's a dinosaur! Help! Help!
lines.zh: 它们在这儿呢！吼！恐龙！啊！是恐龙！救命！救命！

lines.en: Oh, dear, the room is untidy again! Oh! Oh, well, at least it was tidy for a bit!
lines.zh: 哦，天哪，房间又乱了！哦！哦，算了，至少它整洁过一阵子！
